synopsis: You, there. Can you hear me? / It's as I feared. They're slowing us down. / Do not say that. / Not all of us are here for love of battle. / He fights to defend his homeland. / Your name? / Reks, sir. / My name's Reks. / Good. Reks. / You bore a few cuts, but you are still whole. / Well, can you stand? / Think you can fight? / I'm fine, sir. / How old are you, Reks? / Seventeen, sir. / Young. Family? / My brother is all I have left, sir. / He's two years younger than I. Living in Rabanastre. / So young. / You're barely old enough to be a man. You shouldn't be forced to wield a sword. / No, sir. I want to fight. / For my homeland and for my parents. / Time, Basch! Save the discussion for later. / We must reach the King before they act! Or all our efforts will be in vain. / I'm aware of the situation. / - We've found them! - Over there! / Vossler, go ahead! I will handle this rabble. / Godspeed. / Steady, Reks. / Keep your wits about you and you'll make it. / We move!
plays_when: at the start of a new game, on the first entry to Aerial Gardens (Nalbina Fortress), the map a new game starts on (zone-openings.tsv: its way in is the new game start): its director plays it while the Nalbina Fortress progress byte (global byte 0x221) is below 10 (naf_a01 常駐監督.main lines 172, 247 and 249), and the same pass sets the story counter to 13 (After Reks wakes) and the byte to 10 (lines 260 and 261). Every store of global byte 0x221 outside the developer scenario menu is in the Nalbina Fortress maps and writes 10 or more: 10 (naf_a01 line 261), 20, 26, 27 and 28 (naf_a02 lines 235, 337, 1140 and 1401), 30 and 35 (naf_b01 lines 270 and 574), 40 and 45 (naf_b02 lines 883 and 1082) and 50 (naf_b04 line 182). The developer scenario menu (evt_t0505, developer-scenes.tsv) also stores 20, 0, 35, 26, 28 and 27 (evt_t0505 lines 591, 695, 1138, 1208, 1211 and 1214), so the byte is below 10 again only through that menu, and in story play the scene plays once.

synopsis: A sound-only scene: its director loads event sound slot 0 of the scene's own sound file and plays its first sound.
plays_when: in Aerial Gardens (Nalbina Fortress), in the tutorial at the start of a new game, when the party examines the Iron Gate: this sound-only scene (nalbina-fortress-scenes.tsv) is read in the director's first-entry pass, while the Nalbina Fortress progress byte (global byte 0x221) is below 10 (naf_a01 lines 172, 258 and 259; see naf_a0100's row), and is played only from the gate's talk. The gate (the script's 鉄柵) starts with its talk off (naf_a01 line 2015); its function that shows the gate's field sign, labelled "Iron Gate" (message 4), turns the talk on (naf_a01 lines 2064, 2066, 2068 and 2072), and the tutorial requests that function (naf_a01 lines 387, 2551, 2784 and 3072). With the tutorial's step, a file variable (naf_a01 line 129), at 4 to 6, the talk (naf_a01 lines 2019, 2021 and 2023) requests the function that plays the scene (the script's 元読み込み監督.SE, naf_a01 lines 1198, 1200 and 2043). The script sets that step to 5 when the party talks to the Dalmascan (the script's DAL_SOLDIER_A) at step 2 (naf_a01 lines 3027, 3029, 3031 and 3071), and to 6 in the field-sign lessons (naf_a01 lines 394, 2558 and 2791); its other stores are 0, 1 and 2 (naf_a01 lines 279, 281 and 1982).

plays_when: in Inner Ward (Nalbina Fortress): on the first entry, the director's init sets the Nalbina Fortress progress byte (global byte 0x221) to 20 when it is at most 20 (naf_a02 常駐監督.init lines 230, 232 and 235), so the main's case for at most 20 (常駐監督.main lines 273 and 275) runs with the byte at 20: it reads the scene and plays it (lines 279 and 281) and sets the story counter to 16 (After tutorial 1) and the byte to 26 (lines 336 and 337). It plays again on any later entry while the byte is still 26 (lines 343, 344 and 346). That ends when the party defeats the Remora there: the touch of the Remora's area (the script's レモラレクト.touchon), with the Remora's battle byte at 1 (line 1034), requests the Remora's death step (line 1129) and then sets that battle byte to 2 and the progress byte to 27 (lines 1139 and 1140). Every store of global byte 0x221 is listed in naf_a0100's row.

synopsis: Vossler. Where are you? / What if Captain Azelas has fallen? / Don't talk such nonsense! / Vossler's laughed in the face of Death far too many times for him to stop now. / Men like him don't die in places like this. / We must make haste to reach the King. We will take him to safety. / Is His Majesty unharmed? / He'll agree to an unconditional surrender. / They would not dare touch him until the wax on his seal is dry. / But if we arrive after he's signed the treaty— / Wait. / Quickly, Reks!

synopsis: Your Majesty... / Captain, why? / Our king— What have you done? / The King intended all along to sell Dalmasca to the Empire. / His Majesty was a traitor. / Captain, I— / Seize the insurgent! / M'lord! / Well, so much for peaceful negotiations. / We'll never surrender to you! / We are not cattle to be sold by a traitor-king! / But the war is over, my dear captain. / You have lost. / Dalmasca is the property of the Empire, now. / And to think, we intended to let you keep some of your sovereignty, out of respect. / But now you've gone and ruined that. / Haven't you, Captain? / We will never bow to you! / And the people of Dalmasca will hate you for it. / Take the Captain away. / Vaan...
plays_when: In The Highhall (Nalbina Fortress), when the party walks into the hall's area (the script's 大広間レクト) with the story counter below 25 (After Reks's death): the area is on from arrival while the counter is below 25 (naf_b04 lines 518, 559 and 561), and its touch, with the counter below 25 (lines 592 and 594), reads the scene and plays it (lines 638 and 640), waits for its end (line 641), sets the counter to 25 (After Reks's death) (line 644) and takes the party to Overflow Cloaca (Garamsythe Waterway), field 1145, entrance 0 (line 646).
